role.altitude: The clinical research coordinator keeps talking with sponsors, auditors, providers and participants and handling shipments; mailing about visit dates, gathering audit documents, filling order forms and retyping follow-up answers shrink.
skills_to_grow: Keeping the electronic site file audit-ready all the time
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator whose site is ready for an audit on any day without a week of preparation.

tasks.short: Have the sponsor's monitor book site visits, prepare the visits, answer questions about incomplete data in the data capture tool and maintain contact with sponsors by phone and mail.

steps.what: Sponsor monitor books a site visit date: by mail back and forth today, on the booking page after the change
Clinical research coordinator schedules and coordinates site visits with sponsors
Clinical research coordinator prepares the visit: room, record access and files
Clinical research coordinator answers sponsor queries about incomplete data in the data capture tool

loop.input: The open query and source documents in the hospital record.
loop.output: A proposed value for the queried field with its source passage.
loop.check: The coordinator checks that the source passage really supports the proposed value and that the value answers what the query asks, then approves or corrects it before answering; values without a clear source are looked up by hand.
loop.why_not_simpler: Missing values sit in free-text notes.

steps.what: Clinical research coordinator answers sponsors' other questions by phone and mail

tasks.design: The monitor books visits on a booking page that shows the coordinator's free slots and the monitoring room, instead of mail back and forth. A visit checklist covers room, record access for the monitor and files. Queries about incomplete data are answered in the data capture tool, which proposes the missing value from the hospital record with its source passage for the coordinator to check. Other questions stay with the coordinator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Visit dates and query answers went back and forth by mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Booking pages and data capture tools that propose values from source documents.
tasks.still_hard: Queries about data that were never recorded.
tasks.human_edge: Keeping a good working relationship with the monitor.

evidence.claim: A data capture tool proposes case report form values from source documents; a person approves each.

assumptions: Boundary: contact with sponsors about visits and data; the monitoring itself is the sponsor's.
Input contract for s2: the coordinator's calendar and the monitoring room calendar shown on the booking page; monitors' booking effort is about what a mail took and sits in s1.
Input contract for s4: source documents readable by the data capture tool for studies that have it, about 60%; s4 is priced at that share.
Other sponsor questions keep their full time. s3 keeps 85: the monitoring room is booked with the visit on the booking page; arranging record access and files stays with the coordinator.

already_counted.description: Clinical research coordinator checks proposed values before answering queries.

incremental.description: Clinical research coordinator keeps the booking page's free slots current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: monitors keep mailing dates, so s2 keeps 80, and the tool reads the record in only a third of studies, so s4 keeps 85 (12.3); high: booking page used and about 60% of studies with the tool as assumed (21.8).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare for quality assurance audits by collecting documents and checking the site file, participate in audits by sponsors, agencies or review groups, and follow up findings.

steps.what: Clinical research coordinator collects documents requested for the audit
Clinical research coordinator checks the site file for completeness before the audit
Clinical research coordinator participates in quality assurance audits and walks the auditors through
Clinical research coordinator writes corrective actions for audit findings with owner and due date and follows them up: in a list and by mail today, in the findings register after the change
Clinical research coordinator checks the final corrective actions: the finding each answers, what must change, owner and due date
Clinical research coordinator assigns the checked actions to their owners in the findings register

tasks.design: With an electronic site file kept current during the study, requested sections are exported with their version history instead of gathered from binders, and a completeness checklist per study lists missing or expired documents. Taking part in the audit stays human. The coordinator writes corrective actions, checks them and assigns them in a register with owners, due dates and reminders.

approvals.approved_version: The corrective actions with the finding each answers, what must change, owner and due date exactly as checked by the coordinator in s4b, assigned once to the named owners in the findings register; any change needs a new check.

tasks.previous_blocker: Audit preparation meant days of checking paper binders.
tasks.enabler_now: Electronic site files with completeness checklists and export.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining calmly to an auditor why something was done.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation; the audit stays human.

reach.learn: Whether audits find fewer missing documents.

evidence.claim: A compliance platform has audit, incident and monitoring modules.
Records apps with versions and review dates replace spreadsheets and binders.

assumptions: Boundary: preparing for, taking part in and following up an audit.
Input contract for s1 and s2: documents filed in the electronic site file during the study by the coordinator and study staff; about 80% of studies have one; s1 and s2 are priced at that share.
The audit itself keeps its full time.
unknowns: How often audits occur per study.

incremental.description: Clinical research coordinator keeps completeness checklists per study.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: only half of studies keep the electronic site file current, so s1 keeps 75 and s2 keeps 80 (13.9); high: about 80% of studies with a current electronic site file as assumed (26.4).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check study drug and device stock, prepare the order for drugs or devices necessary for study completion, have it approved, send it to the sponsor and receive and record shipments.

steps.what: Clinical research coordinator checks stock of study drugs and devices
Clinical research coordinator prepares the order for drugs or devices
Hospital pharmacist checks the final order, its items, quantities, study and delivery address, and approves it
Clinical research coordinator sends the approved order to the sponsor or supplier
Clinical research coordinator receives shipments and records receipt with the temperature log

tasks.design: Stock per study comes from the sponsor's randomisation and supply portal, which counts kits dispensed by the pharmacy, with a reorder level per item, instead of counting and keeping a spreadsheet. The order form fills from the stock list. The hospital pharmacist approves and the coordinator sends. At receipt the coordinator scans kit numbers and uploads the shipment's temperature logger file.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock was counted and orders written by hand per study.
tasks.enabler_now: Sponsor supply portals with stock per site and scanning at receipt.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting that a damaged kit must not be used.

evidence.claim: Records apps with notifications replace registers held in spreadsheets.

assumptions: Boundary: ordering and receiving study supplies; dispensing is the pharmacy's.
Input contract for s1: kits dispensed recorded by the hospital pharmacy in the sponsor's portal; about 70% of studies use such a portal; others still count by hand; s1 is priced at that share.
Approval and sending keep their full time; the pharmacist's time is outside the coordinator's savings.
unknowns: Share of studies with supply portals.
research_questions: Do stock-outs at the site fall?

incremental.description: Clinical research coordinator sets reorder levels per study.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: only half of studies use a supply portal, so stock is still counted and s1 keeps 70, and the order form is often filled by hand, so s2 keeps 85 (19.9); high: about 70% of studies with a portal and the order form filled from the stock list (31.8).

approvals.approved_version: The order with items, quantities, study and delivery address exactly as checked and approved by the hospital pharmacist in s3, sent once to the sponsor's supply portal or the named supplier; any change goes back for a new check and approval.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Have participants complete follow-up questionnaires, communicate with subjects, contact outside health care providers to obtain follow-up information, enter it in the case report form and chase missing information.

steps.what: Study participant completes the follow-up questionnaire: by phone with the coordinator today, online after the change
Clinical research coordinator communicates with subjects by phone to obtain follow-up information

Clinical research coordinator asks outside health care providers for records: by phone and mail today; prepares a standard request in the regional care exchange after the change and follows up providers who do not reply
Clinical research coordinator checks each request: participant, consent on file, provider and the records asked for
Clinical research coordinator sends each checked request through the regional care exchange and receives the records
Clinical research coordinator enters follow-up information in the case report form
Clinical research coordinator chases missing follow-up information

tasks.design: Participants who can complete follow-up questionnaires online do so, and the answers go straight into the case report form; others are called as today. The coordinator prepares records requests to outside providers as a standard request in the regional care exchange, checks each against the participant's consent and sends it. A list in the data capture tool shows overdue follow-ups instead of a spreadsheet.

approvals.approved_version: Each records request with participant, consent reference and the records asked for exactly as checked by the coordinator in s3b, sent once through the regional care exchange to the named provider; any change needs a new check.

tasks.previous_blocker: Follow-up was gathered by phone and letter and typed into forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Online participant questionnaires linked to data capture tools and regional care exchanges.
tasks.still_hard: Participants who move or stop responding.
tasks.human_edge: Keeping participants engaged over years of follow-up.
tasks.altitude: Fewer calls and less typing; contact stays personal.

reach.learn: Whether standard requests get faster replies.

evidence.claim: A data capture platform proposes form values from source documents; a person approves each.
Online questionnaires can feed answers into study forms.

assumptions: Boundary: obtaining and recording follow-up information; analysis is outside.
Input contract for s4: questionnaire answers from participants who use the online form, about 60%; the rest are called and typed; s4 is priced at that share.
Participants' effort on the online questionnaire is about what the phone call took and sits in s1.
s4 is part of keeping case report forms, which sibling task 11-9121.01:15614 covers; its saving is counted there, so s4 keeps its full time here.
unknowns: Share of participants who answer online.

incremental.description: Clinical research coordinator helps participants who struggle with the online form.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: only about a third of participants answer online, so s2 keeps 90, and many providers are not on the exchange, so s3 keeps 80 (10.6); high: about 60% answer online and most providers use the exchange (19.7).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
